metadata.scenario: A customer calls the billing department to dispute a charge on their latest statement, claiming it was incorrect. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Betty Lou Smith. I’m calling about a charge on my latest statement. Hi Betty, I’m happy to help. Can you tell me what the charge is that you’re disputing? Yes, there’s a charge for $110 for physical therapy that I don’t think is correct. I see. Let me pull up your account to check the details on that. One moment, please. Okay, I have your account here. It shows that the charge was for one session of physical therapy, but I can see you were scheduled for two sessions last week. That’s right, but I only had one session. The therapist didn’t show up for the second one. I apologize for the inconvenience, Betty. I’ll look into why that second session was billed. Thank you. I appreciate that. It’s been a bit frustrating with all the billing issues lately. I completely understand, and I’m here to resolve it for you. I’ll need to check with our scheduling team. Can I get your permission to place you on hold for just a couple of minutes while I verify this? Sure, that’s fine. Thank you for holding, Betty. I’ve confirmed that there was an error in the billing for that missed session. I will remove that charge from your account. That’s a relief! I was worried about that bill. I totally understand. I’ll also send you a corrected statement by email once it’s updated. Great, thank you. I really appreciate your help with this. It’s my pleasure! Is there anything else you would like to discuss while I have you on the line? Actually, yes. I’d like to know more about your companion care services. Of course! Our companion care is available at $25 to $30 per hour, offering social interaction and light housekeeping. That sounds helpful. I live alone and could use some extra support. We can definitely assist you with that. Would you like me to connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa, for a detailed discussion? Yes, that would be great! Perfect, I’ll transfer you to Lisa next. Is there anything else I should note for her? Just that I prefer consistent caregivers, if possible. Noted! I’ll make sure she’s aware of that preference. One moment while I transfer you. Thank you for your patience, Betty! Transferring you now. Have a great day!
